title: Former Kaichi School — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The former Kaichi School is a National Treasure designed by a local master carpenter in1876, in the giyofu/pseudo-Western architectural style.
facts.excerpt: was designed by a local master carpenter in 1876

facts.fact: The façade has an octagonal tower and a mixture of arched windows, dragon/cloud motifs and angels.
facts.excerpt: your gaze is drawn to the octagonal tower.

facts.fact: Visitor access to the first and second floors is by stairs to preserve the original building.
facts.excerpt: you can only do so using the stairs

facts.fact: Visitors change into slippers; flash and photography of display-case materials are restricted.
facts.excerpt: Please refrain from flash photography and taking pictures of the materials in display cases

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
